items.title: 20.2.2 Steps of Recombinant DNA Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 157-160).

items: DNA ki kataai: source DNA restriction endonuclease se kaat kar gene of interest alag kiya jata; vector DNA (plasmid ya viral DNA) usi enzyme se kaata jata, is liye gene aur vector par mutabiq sticky ends bante hain.
Recombinant DNA ki tayyari: kata vector aur gene DNA ligase ke saath rakhe jate jo unhein phosphodiester rabt se jorta hai, aur vector gene wala recombinant vector ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: source DNA jis se surkh gene of interest do restriction sites par kaata gaya, sticky ends wala gene. Oopar daen: neela bacterial plasmid usi enzyme se khola gaya. Neeche: DNA ligase gene ko plasmid mein jor kar recombinant plasmid banata hai, jise bacterium le leta aur taqseem ke saath copy karta hai.
blocks.caption: Recombinant plasmid banana aur us ki cloning (Figures 20.2 aur 20.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Source DNA ko restriction endonuclease se kaat kar gene of interest alag kiya jata hai, aur vector, yahan plasmid, usi enzyme se kaata jata hai, is liye dono par mutabiq sticky ends hote hain. DNA ligase ke saath rakhne par gene plasmid mein phosphodiester bonds se jur jata aur recombinant plasmid banta hai. Usi medium ke bacteria recombinant DNA le lete hain aur barhte hue gene ki aik jaisi copies wale clones banate hain.

blocks.text: Recombinant vector aur expression system, aam taur par bacteria, aik hi medium mein rakhe jate aur bacterial cells recombinant DNA le lete hain. Bacteria barh kar clones banate hain jin mein gene of interest ki aik jaisi copies, clones, hoti hain.

items: Vector ke liye intikhab (antibiotic muzahimat): plasmid mein antibiotic muzahimat ka gene hota hai, aur bacteria us antibiotic (maslan ampicillin) wale medium par ugaye jate hain, is liye sirf plasmid lene wale cells bachte hain.

Gene of interest ke liye intikhab (blue-white screening): plasmid ka lacZ' gene aisa enzyme banata hai jo khaas sugar par amal kar ke use neela karta hai. Saada plasmid lacZ' ko chalne deta aur colony neeli hoti hai; kamyabi se dala gaya gene lacZ' tor deta hai, is liye matloob recombinant colonies safaid rehti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: teen bacteria, aik baghair plasmid (antibiotic se mar jata), aik saade plasmid wala jis ka lacZ' gene kaam karta (neeli colony), aur aik recombinant plasmid wala jis ka insert lacZ' tor deta (safaid colony). Daen: antibiotic aur khaas sugar wali plate, neeli aur safaid colonies; safaid colony rakhne ke liye nishan zada.
blocks.caption: Antibiotic intikhab aur blue-white screening (Figure 20.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Transformation ke baad bacteria ampicillin jaise antibiotic wale medium par ugaye jate hain. Plasmid mein is ke khilaf muzahimat ka gene hai, is liye sirf plasmid lene wale cells bachte hain. Saade aur recombinant plasmids mein farq ke liye plasmid ka lacZ' gene use hota hai: yeh enzyme banata hai jo medium ki khaas sugar par amal kar ke use neela kar deta hai. Agar gene of interest lacZ' mein dala gaya ho to gene toot jata hai, is liye recombinant colonies safaid aur saade plasmid wali neeli hoti hain.

blocks.text: Khaas gene ki pehchaan (DNA hybridization): gene ki maujoodgi ki tasdeeq ke liye radioactive probe, yaani gene ka complementary DNA strand, use hota hai. Yeh sirf gene wali colonies se hybridize hota hai, aur photographic film se autoradiography master plate par in colonies ka pata deti hai.

blocks.alt: Qatar mein paanch gol plates. 1: safaid colonies ki master plate. 2: is par dabaya filter colonies ki copy rakhta hai. 3: cells tore aur DNA strands alag. 4: radioactive probe do colonies se jurta, sitaron se nishan. 5: photographic film do gehre dhabbe dikhati jo master plate par chunne wali colonies batate hain.
blocks.caption: Hybridization se gene wali colonies dhoondna (Figure 20.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kaun si colonies mein gene of interest hai, is ki tasdeeq ke liye radioactive probe use hota hai: gene ka complementary DNA strand. Colonies master plate se filter par copy hoti, cells tor kar un ka DNA single-stranded kiya jata aur probe dala jata hai. Yeh sirf gene wali colonies se hybridize hota hai, aur photographic film par autoradiography un ki jagah dikhati hai, taa ke master plate se mutabiq zinda colonies chuni ja saken.

blocks.prompt: Ampicillin wali plate par kaun si colonies chunenge: neeli ya safaid? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Safaid. Jo bhi colony ugti hai us mein plasmid hai (ampicillin muzahimat), lekin sirf safaid mein dale gaye gene ne lacZ' tora hai, yaani plasmid recombinant hai.

items: Gene aur vector aik hi enzyme se kaatein; ligase se jorein.
Bacteria vector le kar clone karte.
Chhaan been: antibiotic baghair plasmid cells maarta; safaid colonies recombinant; probe gene ki tasdeeq karta.
